PHYSICS-CONSTRAINED SURROGATE OPTIMIZATION OF MEMS PIEZORESISTIVE PRESSURE SENSOR WITH CO-DESIGNED DIGITAL FILTERING CHAIN FOR HIGHPERFORMANCE BIOMEDICAL APPLICATIONS

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
Kotyk M., Kukuruza V. Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) 2026-07-27 10.5281/zenodo.21617946
相关性: 该论文提出了一种物理约束的代理优化框架，结合POD和高斯过程，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的快速仿真与多目标优化。
边界: 该论文未涉及植入物力学、应力遮挡或生物力学有限元分析，而是聚焦于MEMS压力传感器及其信号链的协同设计。
动机· 传统传感器与滤波器分离设计导致系统性能次优，需统一优化。
方法· 构建POD-GP协同模拟器，融合物理约束与数据驱动，进行贝叶斯多目标优化。
结果· 获得Pareto最优设计，无需昂贵仿真，加速设计周期。
验证· 基于有限元仿真案例验证，无实验测试。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Conventional separate design of sensor geometry and digital filter leads to suboptimal system performance, necessitating a unified co-design approach.
Method· A physics-constrained surrogate framework combining proper orthogonal decomposition and a physics-informed Gaussian process is proposed to jointly optimize sensor geometry and filter coefficients via Bayesian multi-objective optimization.
Result· The framework yields a Pareto-optimal set of design variables, achieving high sensitivity, low nonlinearity, and low noise without costly simulations.
Validation· The method is validated through finite element simulation cases, without experimental or clinical validation.

相关性: 该综述系统总结了复合材料损伤建模中的不确定性量化与有限元模型修正方法，其方法论可迁移至植入物力学仿真与代理模型开发。
边界: 该论文聚焦于复合材料损伤建模，未涉及植入物生物力学、骨-植入物界面或医疗设备设计，且缺乏针对生物医学应用的验证。
动机· 复合材料结构安全关键应用中的损伤预测存在显著不确定性，需系统梳理UQ与FEMU方法。

Motivation· The paper aims to systematically review uncertainty quantification and finite element model updating approaches for composite damage modeling, addressing the significant uncertainties in safety-critical applications.
Method· It classifies uncertainty sources, compares deterministic, probabilistic, and non-probabilistic strategies, and analyzes continuum and discrete damage models along with deterministic and Bayesian FEMU workflows.
Result· The survey identifies key research gaps including benchmark standardization, scalable high-fidelity UQ, model-form uncertainty treatment, and integration with digital twin frameworks.
Validation· As a review, it provides no experimental validation but synthesizes existing literature to offer practical guidance.

单位: Jiangsu Provincial Engineering Research Center for Laser Additive Manufacturing of High-Performance Components, College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astro
通讯: Dongdong Gu @ Jiangsu Provincial Engineering Research Center for Laser Additive Manufacturing of High-Performance Components, College
相关性: 该论文研究了LPBF工艺参数对WE43镁合金成形质量和力学性能的影响，虽未涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽，但其工艺优化方法可迁移至生物医用植入物的增材制造。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, focusing instead on process optimization and static mechanical properties of a solid magnesium alloy.
动机· 镁合金因高反应性和高蒸气压，LPBF加工窗口窄，需优化激光能量密度以获得高质量和高性能。
方法· 在不同激光能量密度下制备WE43镁合金，分析成形质量、微观结构和力学性能，确定最优参数。
结果· 在185 J/mm³能量密度下，表面粗糙度约11.2 μm，孔隙率0.1%，抗拉强度329 MPa，延伸率6.1%。
验证· 通过实验测量表面粗糙度、孔隙率、显微组织和拉伸性能进行验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The high reactivity and vapor pressure of magnesium alloys narrow the LPBF processing window, necessitating optimization of laser energy density to achieve high quality and performance.
Method· WE43 magnesium alloy samples were fabricated at varying laser energy densities, and their forming quality, microstructure, and mechanical properties were systematically characterized.
Result· An optimal energy density of 185 J/mm³ yielded minimal surface roughness (~11.2 μm) and porosity (0.1%), with ultimate tensile strength of ~329 MPa and elongation of ~6.1%.
Validation· Validation was performed through experimental measurements of surface roughness, porosity, microstructure, and tensile properties.

Motivation· Local validation in scientific machine learning cannot guarantee that explanations assemble into a globally coherent account, motivating a computable audit framework.

Result· Across synthetic PDE systems and out-of-distribution FNO monitoring, SEAM identifies incompatible explanations even when local predictions are accurate, attributing failures to specific channels and overlaps.
Validation· The framework is validated through nineteen numerical experiments on synthetic PDE systems and FNO monitoring, demonstrating its ability to detect global inconsistencies.

Motivation· To address the high computational cost and label data dependency in multiphysics simulations by developing a finite element-guided operator learning framework.
Method· The proposed method extends finite element-guided physics-informed operator learning to coupled PDEs using a weighted residual formulation, implemented in JAX-based Folax, and evaluates FNO, DeepONet, and iFOL architectures.

动机· 突破TPMS结构密度驱动设计瓶颈，实现局部曲率精确调控。

Motivation· To overcome the density-driven design limitation of TPMS lattices and enable precise local curvature customization for enhanced mechanical performance.
Method· A discrete geometric reconstruction approach was proposed to modulate local curvature in Gyroid lattices, and a Curvature-Volume Fraction model was established to correlate curvature with mechanical properties.
Result· Curvature modulation altered failure mode from shear band to layer-by-layer, increasing yield strength by ~33% and elastic modulus by ~29% compared to standard Gyroids.
Validation· Curvature-modulated Gyroid scaffolds were fabricated from WE43 magnesium alloy via laser powder bed fusion and subjected to mechanical testing.

Motivation· To enhance the imaging stability of coaxial dual-mirror optical systems under service conditions by optimizing assembly process parameters.
Method· A finite element model of the optical system with threaded structures is built to simulate bolt tightening and coupled-field effects; Zernike polynomials and Zemax optical simulation are integrated to link assembly stress to imaging quality, and a LightGBM-based surrogate model is trained to predict the energy concentration ratio, followed by a Pareto-based multi-objective genetic algorithm to optimize bolt torques.
Result· The surrogate model achieves over 95% prediction accuracy, and the optimized process parameters improve the initial and post-service energy concentration ratios by 4.37% and 11.2% on average, respectively.

Motivation· To overcome the accuracy limitations of separable invariant-based hyperelastic models and the computational cost of fully coupled data-driven approaches.
Method· A bivariate B-spline surface is defined on the physically admissible invariant domain, and calibration is performed directly from homogeneous deformation modes, reducing the problem to a constrained linear least-squares fit.
Result· The proposed model achieves higher accuracy than separable models while maintaining fast, robust, and initialization-independent calibration, making it suitable for repeated calibration tasks.

Motivation· Autonomous exploration missions require decision-making under sensor uncertainty and computational constraints, yet integrating scientific representations into POMDP planning remains intractable.
Method· The paper introduces the Science Hypothesis Map POMDP (SHM-POMDP), which branches on inferred physical properties rather than raw sensor data, preserving full sensor information through learned observation models.
Result· SHM-POMDP achieves higher rewards and reduced computation time on RockSample, and higher information gain on Cuprite hyperspectral data compared to baselines.
Validation· The method is validated through numerical benchmarks on an extended RockSample domain and realistic geologic exploration using Cuprite hyperspectral data.

Motivation· To elucidate the mechanism by which aging-induced precipitation affects the corrosion resistance of SLM-processed lightweight steel.

Motivation· Standard pushers for relativistic charged particles either lack symplectic structure or accumulate secular errors over long times, motivating a symmetry-preserving surrogate approach.

动机· 探讨Fink主动学习模型对伊拉克童子军教育概念获取与保持的影响。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of the Fink Active Learning Model in improving scouting concept acquisition and retention among undergraduate students, addressing a gap in physical education research.
Method· An experimental equivalent-groups post-test-only design was used, with one group taught via the Fink model and a control group via conventional methods over a ten-week period.
Result· The experimental group showed significantly higher scores in both acquisition and retention tests, with medium to large effect sizes.
Validation· Validation was conducted through a validated 45-item test and non-parametric statistical analysis (Mann-Whitney U tests).

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine whether preoperative hip abductor muscle strength can predict patient-reported functional outcomes at 12 months after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A prospective cohort study of 163 patients used adjusted linear mixed-effects models to assess the association between preoperative abductor strength and 12-month HOOS-JR and VR-12 scores.
Result· Greater preoperative abductor strength was independently associated with higher HOOS-JR and VR-12 scores, increased odds of achieving MCID, and lower odds of not reaching PASS.
Validation· Validation was performed using clinical follow-up data from a single institution's prospective cohort.
